        self.spy_close_prev = None
        self.spy_sma_prev = None

        self.aapl_close_history = RollingWindow[float](5)

        self.lotA_shares = 0
        self.lotB_shares = 0

        for t in self.tickers:
            if not data.ContainsKey(t) or data[t] is None:
                return

        spy_close = data[self.spy].Close
        aapl_close = data[self.aapl].Close

        self.aapl_close_history.Add(aapl_close)

        if not self.sma.IsReady or not self.rsi.IsReady or not self.aapl_close_history.IsReady:
            self.spy_close_prev = spy_close
            self.spy_sma_prev = self.sma.Current.Value if self.sma.IsReady else None
            return

        sma_value = self.sma.Current.Value
        rsi_value = self.rsi.Current.Value

        # Sells before buys

        # Strategy A sell
        if self.lotA_shares > 0:
            if self.spy_close_prev is not None and self.spy_sma_prev is not None:
                crossed_below = (self.spy_close_prev >= self.spy_sma_prev) and (spy_close < sma_value)
                if crossed_below:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.lotA_shares)
                    self.lotA_shares = 0

        # Strategy B sell
        if self.lotB_shares > 0:
            if rsi_value > 60:
                self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.lotB_shares)
                self.lotB_shares = 0

        # Strategy A buy

                        self.MarketOrder(self.spy, shares)
                        self.lotA_shares += shares

                        self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, shares)
                        self.lotB_shares += shares

        self.spy_close_prev = spy_close
        self.spy_sma_prev = sma_value
